rules.baselines: G1 uses one initial profile per test, never a new profile after its first check; B1-17 may add only lab-f before that check while keeping the original OIS snapshot exact. Extra migration profiles reuse the exact first snapshot of each (test, role, PID); new reference PIDs must first appear before that test begins any cleanup check.

rules.other_records: Validate every emitted resource record, including G4 records outside the required G1 test list.
